The approach is inspired by Meta's highly successful internal AI review system, where production incidents fell 50x and rollbacks 3x. LLM + incident-trained ML + code-graph analysis. @agshin_rajabovThanks Agshin, for engaging!

Short answer: Yes, the size of the code is only one of the signals we use. We have blast radius analysis based on AST, production feedback, keywords, approval levels and such things to make it more intelligent.

On top of that -- the ML system can learn over time from production behaviors (incidents, rollback) to know which parts of code are tricky, etc as well.

The thing is -- over time -- the system level performance will improve -- lower downtime, reduced incidents, rollbacks, etc. So we aim for that.
